message.content:
Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most notable players who have worn the Los Angeles Clippers jersey over the years—both past legends and current stars:

| Era | Notable Players (selected) |
|-----|----------------------------|
| **Early Years (1970s‑80s)** | *Kenny Smith*, *Moses Malone* (brief stint), *Bill Walton* (short tenure) |
| **1990s** | *Gary Payton* (first All‑Star with the Clippers), *Chris Webber* (brief stint), *Julius Erving* (short stint) |
| **2000s (pre‑Kawhi era)** | *Blake Griffin* (first All‑Star), *DeAndre Jordan* (long‑time core), *Chris Paul* (first All‑Star), *Jamal Crawford* (key role player) |
| **2010s (Kawhi & Paul era)** | *Kawhi Leonard* (first All‑Star), *Paul George* (first All‑Star), *Reggie Jackson* (key role player), *Julius Randle* (All‑Star), *Jamal Crawford* (role player) |
| **2020s (current core)** | *Paul George* (All‑Star), *Kawhi Leonard* (All‑Star), *Reggie Jackson* (All‑Star), *Julius Randle* (All‑Star), *Jalen Green* (rookie star), *Bam Adebayo* (role player), *Jabari Parker* (role player) |

### Current (2025‑26) Clippers Roster Highlights
- **Paul George** – 7× All‑Star, 2× All‑NBL First Team
- **Kawhi Leonard** – 6× All‑Star, 2× All‑NBL First Team
- **Reggie Jackson** – 2× All‑NBL First Team
- **Julius Randle** – 2× All‑NBL First Team
- **Jalen Green** – 1× All‑NBL First Team (rookie)
- **Bam Adebayo** – 1× All‑NBL First Team (role player)

These names represent just a handful of the many players who have contributed to the Clippers’ history—from early pioneers to the modern superstars leading the team today.
